info.title: TierList API
info.description: FastAPI backend of the TierList application

post.description:
Creates an account with an email and a password, opens its session and sends the verification
email in the requested language. The refresh token is set in an HttpOnly cookie.

409.description: Email already registered

post.description:
Opens a session with an email and a password. The refresh token is set in an HttpOnly cookie;
a banned account gets 403 with the reason and, when there is one, the end of the ban.

Gives a new access token from the refresh cookie, and renews that cookie. 204 without a
cookie (no session in this browser); 401 if the session expired or was closed, or if the account
is banned, with the cookie cleared.

204.description: No session cookie: the visitor is not signed in

post.description:
Closes the session of this browser and clears the refresh cookie. The account's access tokens
on other devices are also invalidated: they go through /auth/refresh. 204 even without a
session.

get.description: The signed-in account.

delete.description:
Deletes the signed-in account, after closing the rooms it is the admin of and removing it
from the others. An account with a password must give it again; an account without a password
must have signed in recently. The refresh cookie is cleared.

403.description: Incorrect password, or Google sign-in too old

post.description:
Sends the verification email again; does nothing if the address is already confirmed, or if
the previous email is too recent (EMAIL_COOLDOWN_SECONDS).

Confirms the email address with the token of the received link; no session needed: the link
can be opened in another browser.

get.description: Sends the browser to the Google sign-in page.
Return from Google: checks the response, opens the session, then returns to the frontend.

After a refusal from Google: the same 403 response as a password sign-in, with the reason and
the end of the ban. 204 when there is nothing to show: no cookie or an invalid cookie, ban
lifted or over.

post.description:
Sends a reset link if an account has this address; answers 204 in every case, after queueing
the email as a background task: nothing reveals which addresses have an account.
Sets a new password with the received link; every session is closed.

get.description:
Public browser configuration (error tracking); the backend also writes it into index.html,
this route serves the Vite development server.

The account's active templates, with their number of tiles, most recently modified first.
Each template gives its moderation decision and the images removed from its tiles.

post.description: Creates a template with the six default tiers (S to E) and no tile.

get.description:
The account's templates deleted by moderation and not purged yet, with the date and the
reason.

A template of the account, with its tiers and its tiles sorted by position. 404 for a deleted
template or one of another account.

patch.description: Renames a template; its last modification date is updated.

delete.description:
Deletes a template: it disappears right away for its owner, and it is erased for good after
the retention period. Games already played keep their frozen version.

put.description:
Makes a template public or private, by its owner. Making it public requires a confirmed email
address, a template not hidden by moderation and at least one tile. The date of the first
publication is kept when the template goes back to private.

409.description: Template hidden by the moderation, or without tiles

post.description: Adds a tier at the bottom of the template, named "?", color #9AA0B4.

patch.description:
Changes the name, the color and/or the position of a tier; the other tiers are shifted. A
position past the end puts the tier last.

delete.description: Deletes a tier; the following ones move up. Refused (409) for the template's last tier.

409.description: The last tier of a template cannot be deleted

post.description:
Adds a tile at the end of the template: a text, an image already uploaded by the account
(POST /images), or both. Refused (409) past the maximum number of tiles (`max_tiles`).

409.description: Maximum number of tiles reached

422.description: Tile without text nor image, or invalid request

patch.description:
Changes the text, the image and/or the position of a tile. An explicit `null` removes the
text or the image, as long as the tile keeps the other; `position: null` is ignored.

404.description: Template, tile or image not found

422.description: Tile without text nor image, or invalid request

delete.description: Deletes a tile; the following ones move up.

post.description: Uploads a tile image (JPEG, PNG or WebP), compressed to WebP by the server.

415.description: Not a JPEG, PNG or WebP image

429.description: Too many images uploaded in the last hour

post.description:
Creates an open room on a template of the account, not hidden and with at least one tile. The
account becomes its admin and first participant.

409.description: Template without tiles, or hidden by the moderation

get.description:
The room, its settings, its participants and its current game, for a participant (an account,
or a guest recognized by the room cookie). 403 without a place in the room, so the page can
offer to join it; 404 for an unknown code or a closed room.

403.description: The room exists, but the viewer has no seat in it: join it first

delete.description:
Closes the room (admin only): a game in progress is first closed and kept, then the room, its
places and its bans are deleted. The code and the link stop working.

post.description:
Joins the room as a guest with a nickname. Sets the room cookie and returns the personal
link, given only once.

409.description: Nickname already used, room full, or room locked during a game

post.description:
Gives a guest their place back from the token of their personal link, on any device, and sets
the room cookie.

404.description: Guest link unknown, expired, or room closed

post.description: Gives the guest recognized by the cookie a new personal link; the old one stops working.

Gives the account a player place in the room, with its display name; gives back the same
place if it already has one, even when the room is full or arrivals are blocked.

409.description: Room full, or locked during a game

patch.description:
Changes the room settings (admin only); only the fields sent change. Outside a game, they
apply to the next one; during a game, only `late_arrivals_allowed` can change, and it applies
right away.

409.description: Settings locked during a game, except late arrivals

delete.description:
Removes a participant (admin only, not their own place), at any time; their placements in the
current game go with them. With `ban=true`, the person can no longer come back to the room.

409.description: The room admin cannot be removed

delete.description: Lifts a ban (admin only): the person can come back.

post.description:
Starts a game (admin only) on the current version of the template, frozen for the whole game.
The room moves to `playing` and the first item is shown to everyone.

409.description: Game already in progress, no participant who places, or template deleted, without tiles or hidden by the moderation

put.description:
Places the item of the current round in a tier, at the requested position, on the reader's
private board; placing it again in the same round moves it. During the cooldown, places or moves
any item of the game, including a missed item.

404.description: Room not found, or tier or tile not in the game

403.description: The room admin does not play

409.description: No round nor cooldown in progress, the round or the cooldown is over, or during a round the tile is not the current item

post.description:
Ends the current round (admin only) and shows the next item to everyone, or starts the final
cooldown after the last item. Participants who did not place the item get an absent vote.

409.description: No round in progress (no game, or the cooldown has begun)

post.description:
Ends the final cooldown (admin only): the game is closed and kept, the room goes back to
`open`.

409.description: No final cooldown in progress

get.description:
The results of a closed game, by its public link, without an account. `include_absent_votes`
chooses whether absent votes count in the ranking (yes by default).

The account's closed games, most recent first: those it played and those of the rooms it was
the admin of. Paginated by `limit` and `offset`; `has_more` tells whether games are left.

Queue of open reports, grouped by content: the most reported first, then the oldest. Never
the author of a report. Paginated by `limit` and `offset`; `owner_id` keeps the contents of one
account.

Number of reported contents waiting for a decision (contents, not reports), for the
moderation menu.

post.description:
Dismisses the open reports of a content: the content does not change. Written to the
moderation log with the reason.

404.description: No open report on this content

post.description:
Replaces a reported nickname with a neutral code, in rooms and results. Cannot be undone: the
old nickname only stays in the log.

get.description:
The games hidden by moderation, so they can be made visible again. Paginated by `limit` and
`offset`.

post.description: Hides a closed game: its results link answers like an unknown link.

409.description: Game already hidden, or not hidden

post.description:
Makes a hidden game visible: its results link works again. Written to the log with the
reason.

409.description: Game already hidden, or not hidden

get.description:
The moderation log, most recent first. Filters: `actor_id` (a super admin), `target` (text
searched in the target's name, case-insensitive), `account_id` (the decisions about an account,
its templates and its images). Paginated by `limit` and `offset`.
The super admins, by name: the choices of the log's "Super admin" filter.

schema.title: Response List Super Admins Moderation Super Admins Get

post.description:
Hides a visible image: it is no longer served at its public address and shows as "removed"
everywhere. Written to the log with the reason.

409.description: Image already hidden, not hidden, or deleted

post.description: Makes a hidden image visible. Written to the log with the reason.

409.description: Image already hidden, not hidden, or deleted

post.description:
Deletes an image, visible or hidden: its file is erased and it shows as "removed" everywhere.
Written to the log with the reason.

409.description: Image already hidden, not hidden, or deleted

get.description:
The latest uploaded images, most recent first, with their author and their use (templates,
games). Filters: `author` (name or email, case-insensitive), `created_after` and
`created_before`, `status`, `owner_id`. Paginated by `limit` and `offset`.
Reads the content of a non-deleted template, even a private one (US-1.8). Read-only.

post.description:
Hides a template that is neither hidden nor deleted, public or private: it can no longer be
used for a new game, and its owner sees the reason. Written to the log.

409.description: Template already hidden, not hidden, or deleted

post.description:
Lifts the hiding of a template that is not deleted; its public or private visibility does not
change, and the reason is cleared from the template. Written to the log with the reason.

409.description: Template already hidden, not hidden, or deleted

post.description:
Deletes a template, visible or hidden, like a deletion by its owner; the owner sees the
reason until the purge. Written to the log.

409.description: Template already hidden, not hidden, or deleted

get.description:
Searches accounts by name or email, sorted by name. Paginated by `limit` and `offset`;
`has_more` tells whether accounts are left.
The page of an account: its details, its active ban, its past bans and its templates.

post.description:
Hides the visible images of an account, in batches. Send the request again while `has_more`
is true.

409.description: The images of this account are already being hidden

post.description:
Bans an account, until `ends_at` or permanently (`ends_at` null); an active ban is lifted
first. The account is signed out everywhere and can no longer sign in; its contents stay online.
Written to the log.

409.description: Super admin

422.description: Ban end in the past, or invalid request

post.description:
Lifts the active ban of an account: it can sign in again; its sessions stay closed. Written
to the log with the reason.

409.description: Account not banned

post.description: Reports a content, with an account or without one: a cookie then recognizes the browser.

409.description: Open report from the same person on this content

429.description: Too many reports sent in the last hour

AccountBanResponse.title: AccountBanResponse
AccountBanResponse.description: The active ban of an account.

AccountPastBanResponse.title: AccountPastBanResponse
AccountPastBanResponse.description:
A ban that was lifted, replaced by another one or that reached its end: lifted_at is empty in
the last case.

AccountResponse.title: AccountResponse
AccountResponse.description:
The page of an account for the super admins (US-1.8). Its images are read through the latest
uploads filtered on it (owner_id), its history through the log filtered on it (account_id).

AccountSearchResponse.title: AccountSearchResponse
AccountSearchResponse.description: A page of the account search, by name.

AccountSummaryResponse.title: AccountSummaryResponse
AccountSummaryResponse.description: An account in the super admins' search (US-1.8).

BanAccountRequest.title: BanAccountRequest
BanAccountRequest.description: Ban an account (US-1.8): until ends_at, or permanently without a date.

sentry_dsn.title: Sentry Dsn
sentry_dsn.description: Browser Sentry DSN; null when error tracking is disabled.

release.title: Release
release.description: Running version, the same as the one of /health.

ClientConfigResponse.title: ClientConfigResponse
ClientConfigResponse.description:
Public settings read by the frontend at startup.

The same frontend build serves every environment.

CreateReportRequest.title: CreateReportRequest
CreateReportRequest.description:
A report (US-1.2). target_id designates, depending on target_kind: an item of a game, a
participant of a room, a player of the results or a closed game.

CreateTemplateRequest.title: CreateTemplateRequest
CreateTemplateRequest.description: Name of the new template; surrounding spaces are removed.

CreateTileRequest.title: CreateTileRequest
CreateTileRequest.description: Content of the new tile: a text, an image or both, never neither.

CurrentGameResponse.title: CurrentGameResponse

CurrentItemResponse.title: CurrentItemResponse
CurrentItemResponse.description:
An item of the game, a tile of the frozen version: the item of the current round (shown to
everyone), an item placed by the reader, or an item they missed.

DeleteAccountRequest.title: DeleteAccountRequest
DeleteAccountRequest.description:
Confirmation of the account deletion: the password, required for an account that has one,
absent for an account without a password.

DismissReportsRequest.title: DismissReportsRequest
DismissReportsRequest.description: Dismiss the open reports of a content (US-1.3).

EmailVerificationRequest.title: EmailVerificationRequest
EmailVerificationRequest.description: Language of the new verification email.

ForgotPasswordRequest.title: ForgotPasswordRequest
ForgotPasswordRequest.description: Address of the account, and language of the reset email.

GameResultsResponse.title: GameResultsResponse
GameResultsResponse.description: Results of a closed game (US-5.2), read through its link (US-5.3).

GameTierResponse.title: GameTierResponse
GameTierResponse.description: A tier of the frozen version of the game, where items are placed.

server_now.title: Server Now
server_now.description: Server time when the response was made: the client derives the offset of its clock from it, so its timers follow the server ones.

GuestRoomResponse.title: GuestRoomResponse
GuestRoomResponse.description:
Room joined as a guest, with the personal link: given only once, since the database only
keeps its hash.

HiddenGameResponse.title: HiddenGameResponse
HiddenGameResponse.description: A game hidden by moderation: its results link cannot be found.

HiddenGamesResponse.title: HiddenGamesResponse
HiddenGamesResponse.description: A page of the hidden games, most recent first.

HiddenImagesResponse.title: HiddenImagesResponse
HiddenImagesResponse.description:
Result of a batch of "hide all their images": send the request again while `has_more` is
true.

HistoryResponse.title: HistoryResponse
HistoryResponse.description: A page of an account's history (US-5.5).

ImageStatus.title: ImageStatus
ImageStatus.description: Statut de modération (#124) : toute image envoyée est visible.

ImageUploadResponse.title: ImageUploadResponse
ImageUploadResponse.description:
Uploaded and compressed image: its id, to put in a tile, its public address and its
dimensions in pixels.

ItemDistributionResponse.title: ItemDistributionResponse
ItemDistributionResponse.description: Overall view of an item: how many players put it in each tier, and how many were absent.

ItemOrder.title: ItemOrder
ItemOrder.description: Ordre de passage des tuiles pendant une partie.

JoinAsGuestRequest.title: JoinAsGuestRequest
JoinAsGuestRequest.description: Nickname of the guest in the room.

LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest
LoginRequest.description: Sign-in with an email and a password.

ModerationActionKind.title: ModerationActionKind
ModerationActionKind.description: Action d'un super admin, écrite au journal de modération (US-1.9).

ModerationActionResponse.title: ModerationActionResponse
ModerationActionResponse.description: An entry of the moderation log (US-1.9).

ModerationLogResponse.title: ModerationLogResponse
ModerationLogResponse.description: A page of the moderation log.

ModerationReasonRequest.title: ModerationReasonRequest
ModerationReasonRequest.description: The reason for a moderation action, written to the log (US-1.9).

ModerationTargetType.title: ModerationTargetType
ModerationTargetType.description:
Ce sur quoi porte une action de modération : les contenus signalables (US-1.2) et le
compte.

OpenReportCountResponse.title: OpenReportCountResponse
OpenReportCountResponse.description: The number of contents that have at least one open report.

OwnPlacementResponse.title: OwnPlacementResponse
OwnPlacementResponse.description:
An item placed by the reader: its tier and its position (0 = first). Round placement during
the rounds, final placement during the cooldown.

ParticipantResponse.title: ParticipantResponse
ParticipantResponse.description:
A place in the room: an account with its display name, or a guest with their nickname.
`is_you` marks the reader's place.

PastGameResponse.title: PastGameResponse
PastGameResponse.description:
A closed game (past games of a room, history of an account): its results link
(/results/<public_token>).

PlaceItemRequest.title: PlaceItemRequest
PlaceItemRequest.description:
Tier chosen for the item, and position in that tier (0 = first); a position past the end puts
the item last.

PlayerResultsResponse.title: PlayerResultsResponse
PlayerResultsResponse.description: The final ranking of a player.

RecentUploadResponse.title: RecentUploadResponse
RecentUploadResponse.description: An image of the latest uploads (US-1.7).

RecentUploadsResponse.title: RecentUploadsResponse
RecentUploadsResponse.description: A page of the latest uploads.

RegisterRequest.title: RegisterRequest
RegisterRequest.description:
Sign-up with an email and a password; `language` chooses the language of the verification
email.

RemoveNicknameRequest.title: RemoveNicknameRequest
RemoveNicknameRequest.description:
Remove a reported nickname, permanently. target_id is the one of the report: an account, a
participant or a player.

RemovedImageResponse.title: RemovedImageResponse
RemovedImageResponse.description: A tile whose image was hidden or deleted by moderation, with the decision and the reason.

RemovedTemplateListResponse.title: RemovedTemplateListResponse
RemovedTemplateListResponse.description: The account's templates deleted by moderation and not purged yet.

RemovedTemplateResponse.title: RemovedTemplateResponse
RemovedTemplateResponse.description: A template deleted by moderation, not purged yet, with the date and the reason.

RenameTemplateRequest.title: RenameTemplateRequest
RenameTemplateRequest.description: New name of the template; surrounding spaces are removed.

ReportQueueResponse.title: ReportQueueResponse
ReportQueueResponse.description: A page of the report queue, most reported first.

ReportReasonCountResponse.title: ReportReasonCountResponse
ReportReasonCountResponse.description: A report reason and the number of reports that give it.

ReportResponse.title: ReportResponse
ReportResponse.description: The saved report. It tells nothing about its author.

ReportTargetKind.title: ReportTargetKind
ReportTargetKind.description: Ce que désigne target_id dans un signalement (US-1.2).

ReportedContentResponse.title: ReportedContentResponse
ReportedContentResponse.description: A reported content in the queue (US-1.3). It never tells who reported it.

ResetPasswordRequest.title: ResetPasswordRequest
ResetPasswordRequest.description: Token of the reset link received by email, and the new password.

RestoreGuestRequest.title: RestoreGuestRequest
RestoreGuestRequest.description: Token of the guest's personal link.

ReviewedTemplateResponse.title: ReviewedTemplateResponse
ReviewedTemplateResponse.description: The content of a template for the super admins, even a private one (US-1.8).

ReviewedTileResponse.title: ReviewedTileResponse
ReviewedTileResponse.description: A tile read by a super admin: a hidden image stays visible in it, image_status says so.

RoomBanResponse.title: RoomBanResponse
RoomBanResponse.description: A ban from the room, visible to the admin only.

server_now.title: Server Now
server_now.description: Server time when the response was made: the client derives the offset of its clock from it, so its timers follow the server ones.

RoomResponse.title: RoomResponse
RoomResponse.description:
A room as a participant sees it. `version` increases with every change to the room; `bans` is
only filled for the admin; `template` is null when the template was purged; `game` is null
outside a game.

RoomSettingsResponse.title: RoomSettingsResponse
RoomSettingsResponse.description:
Room settings: those of the current game during a game, otherwise those of the next one.
`timer_seconds` is kept even when `auto_advance` is not `timer`.

RoomStatus.title: RoomStatus
RoomStatus.description:
Une salle fermée n'est pas gardée (docs/product/milestone-1/lifecycles.md) : elle est
supprimée, il n'y a donc pas de statut « fermée ».

RoomTemplateResponse.title: RoomTemplateResponse
RoomTemplateResponse.description: Template of the room; `hidden` is true when moderation hid it: no new game can start then.

SuperAdminResponse.title: SuperAdminResponse
SuperAdminResponse.description: A super admin, to filter the log by author.

TemplateListResponse.title: TemplateListResponse
TemplateListResponse.description: The account's templates, most recently modified first.

TemplateModeration.title: TemplateModeration
TemplateModeration.description: Décision de la modération sur un modèle (US-1.5).

TemplateResponse.title: TemplateResponse
TemplateResponse.description:
A template with its tiers and its tiles sorted by position. `max_tiles` is the maximum number
of tiles; `first_made_public_at` is kept when the template goes back to private.

TemplateSummaryResponse.title: TemplateSummaryResponse
TemplateSummaryResponse.description:
A template in the account's list: its number of tiles, its moderation decision and the images
removed from its tiles.

TemplateVisibility.title: TemplateVisibility
TemplateVisibility.description: Visibilité choisie par le propriétaire d'un modèle (US-2.1, US-2.3).

TierItemsResponse.title: TierItemsResponse
TierItemsResponse.description: The items of a tier, in order.

TierResponse.title: TierResponse
TierResponse.description: A tier of the template; position 0 is the top tier.

TileResponse.title: TileResponse
TileResponse.description:
A tile of the template, in the template's order. `image_removed` is true when moderation hid
or deleted the image: `image_url` is then null. `image_status` and `image_moderation_reason` are
only shown to the owner.

TokenResponse.title: TokenResponse
TokenResponse.description:
Access token to send in the `Authorization: Bearer` header, valid for `expires_in` seconds.
The refresh token is never in the body: it is in an HttpOnly cookie.

UpdateRoomSettingsRequest.title: UpdateRoomSettingsRequest
UpdateRoomSettingsRequest.description:
Changes to the room settings: only the fields sent change; a request without a field changes
nothing.

UpdateTierRequest.title: UpdateTierRequest
UpdateTierRequest.description: Changes to a tier: only the fields sent change. The color is in the #RRGGBB format.

UpdateTileRequest.title: UpdateTileRequest
UpdateTileRequest.description:
Changes to a tile: only the fields sent change. `null` removes the text or the image; the
tile must keep one of the two.

UserResponse.title: UserResponse
UserResponse.description:
An account, as its owner sees it. `has_password` is false as long as the account has no
password (a Google account that never set one).

UserRole.title: UserRole
UserRole.description:
Rôle d'un compte (docs/product/milestone-2/domain-model.md). Jamais attribué par
l'application : seulement hors de l'API (scripts/set_super_admin.py en local, une requête SQL
en staging et en production).

VerifyEmailRequest.title: VerifyEmailRequest
VerifyEmailRequest.description: Token of the verification link received by email.

CooldownStartedEvent.description: The last round is over: the final cooldown starts (#96).
CooldownStartedEvent.title: CooldownStartedEvent

GameClosedData.description: The game that was just closed.
GameClosedData.title: GameClosedData

GameClosedEvent.description:
The final cooldown is over (timer or "Finish now"): the game is closed and the room is open
again.
GameClosedEvent.title: GameClosedEvent

GameStartedData.description: First round of the game; `ends_at` is the end of the round when it has a timer.
GameStartedData.title: GameStartedData

GameStartedEvent.description: The room admin started a game: the first item is shown to everyone.
GameStartedEvent.title: GameStartedEvent

ParticipantJoinedEvent.description: An account or a guest just came in: the client reads the room again.
ParticipantJoinedEvent.title: ParticipantJoinedEvent

ParticipantPlacedData.description: The participant who placed the item, and the round concerned.
ParticipantPlacedData.title: ParticipantPlacedData

ParticipantPlacedEvent.description: A participant placed the current item for the first time in this round.
ParticipantPlacedEvent.title: ParticipantPlacedEvent

ParticipantPresenceEvent.description: A participant just connected, or disconnected (grace period over).
ParticipantPresenceEvent.title: ParticipantPresenceEvent

ParticipantRemovedEvent.description: The room admin removed or banned a participant: their place no longer exists.
ParticipantRemovedEvent.title: ParticipantRemovedEvent

PingMessage.description: Server heartbeat: the client answers pong.
PingMessage.title: PingMessage

RoomSettingsUpdatedEvent.description: The room admin changed the settings: the client reads the room again.
RoomSettingsUpdatedEvent.title: RoomSettingsUpdatedEvent

RoundStartedData.description: New round; `ends_at` is the end of the round when it has a timer.
RoundStartedData.title: RoundStartedData

RoundStartedEvent.description:
The previous round is over ("next", timer or "everyone placed"): the next item is shown to
everyone.
RoundStartedEvent.title: RoundStartedEvent

AuthMessage.description:
First message of the client: the access token of an account, or None for a guest (recognized
by their cookie). The token never goes in the URL.
AuthMessage.title: AuthMessage

PongMessage.description: Client reply to the server ping, within `ROOM_HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` (5 s by default).
PongMessage.title: PongMessage
